data.title: risk-high: release owner reservations before completion
data.description: Risk-high review at exact commit acec0982. Root cause: FlatOwner notified append callers through oneshot before the DomainPlan OwnedSemaphorePermit was dropped, allowing completed append metrics to observe owner_intent_bytes_in_use=24 instead of 0. Review OwnerCompletion field/drop ordering and every terminal path (domain/registry success, backend error, conflict, empty, registry-lost, queued cancellation/owner exit/unwind). Verify regression covers successful commit plus conflict, no-op, and abandoned receiver followed by sentinel completion. Checks: focused two-test filter passed 100 repetitions / 200 executions; just fmt-check passed; MESS_SNAPSHOT_LAW_ITERS=25 just test passed 981/981 (27 skipped).
